name: @armoreum/contracts
description: Solidity source for Armoreum creator vaults, reward accounting, token launch infrastructure, and cross-chain bridge components.

scripts.prepare:multichain:bridge-operators: : "${MULTICHAIN_NETWORK:?Set MULTICHAIN_NETWORK to ethereum or robinhood}"; HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true hardhat run scripts/deploy-multichain-bridge-operators.cjs --network "$MULTICHAIN_NETWORK"
scripts.deploy:multichain:bridge-operators: : "${MULTICHAIN_NETWORK:?Set MULTICHAIN_NETWORK to ethereum or robinhood}"; ARMOREUM_DEPLOY_BROADCAST=YES HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true hardhat run scripts/deploy-multichain-bridge-operators.cjs --network "$MULTICHAIN_NETWORK"
scripts.prepare:multichain:vault-bridge-auth: : "${MULTICHAIN_NETWORK:?Set MULTICHAIN_NETWORK to ethereum or robinhood}"; HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true hardhat run scripts/upgrade-multichain-vault-bridge-authorization.cjs --network "$MULTICHAIN_NETWORK"
scripts.upgrade:multichain:vault-bridge-auth: : "${MULTICHAIN_NETWORK:?Set MULTICHAIN_NETWORK to ethereum or robinhood}"; ARMOREUM_DEPLOY_BROADCAST=YES HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true hardhat run scripts/upgrade-multichain-vault-bridge-authorization.cjs --network "$MULTICHAIN_NETWORK"
scripts.prepare:launch-mode-policy: : "${MULTICHAIN_NETWORK:?Set MULTICHAIN_NETWORK to ethereum or robinhood}"; HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true hardhat run scripts/upgrade-launch-mode-policy-mainnet.cjs --network "$MULTICHAIN_NETWORK"
scripts.upgrade:ethereum:launch-mode-policy: ARMOREUM_DEPLOY_BROADCAST=YES ARMOREUM_MODE_POLICY_CONFIRMATION="I confirm Armoreum launch-mode policy setup on ethereum mainnet chain 1" HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true hardhat run scripts/upgrade-launch-mode-policy-mainnet.cjs --network ethereum
scripts.upgrade:robinhood:launch-mode-policy: ARMOREUM_DEPLOY_BROADCAST=YES ARMOREUM_MODE_POLICY_CONFIRMATION="I confirm Armoreum launch-mode policy setup on robinhood mainnet chain 4663" HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true hardhat run scripts/upgrade-launch-mode-policy-mainnet.cjs --network robinhood
scripts.deploy:ethereum:multichain-seed: ARMOREUM_DEPLOY_BROADCAST=YES DEPLOY_ETHEREUM_MAINNET_CONFIRMATION="I confirm deployment to Ethereum mainnet chain 1" HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true hardhat run scripts/deploy-ethereum-multichain-seed.cjs --network ethereum
scripts.deploy:ethereum:hook-factory-v2: ARMOREUM_DEPLOY_BROADCAST=YES DEPLOY_ETHEREUM_MAINNET_CONFIRMATION="I confirm deployment to Ethereum mainnet chain 1" HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true hardhat run scripts/deploy-ethereum-hook-factory-v2.cjs --network ethereum
scripts.deploy:ethereum:hook-factory-v3: ARMOREUM_HOOK_FACTORY_RELEASE=V3 ARMOREUM_DEPLOY_BROADCAST=YES DEPLOY_ETHEREUM_MAINNET_CONFIRMATION="I confirm deployment to Ethereum mainnet chain 1" HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true hardhat run scripts/deploy-ethereum-hook-factory-v2.cjs --network ethereum
scripts.upgrade:ethereum:taxrouter-lockdown-v4: ARMOREUM_EXECUTE_ETHEREUM_TAX_ROUTER_V4=YES DEPLOY_ETHEREUM_MAINNET_CONFIRMATION="I confirm deployment to Ethereum mainnet chain 1" HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true hardhat run scripts/upgrade-ethereum-future-tax-lockdown-v4.cjs --network ethereum
scripts.deploy:ethereum: HARDHAT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY_PROMPT=true ARMOREUM_DEPLOY_TARGET=ethereum hardhat run scripts/deploy.cjs --network ethereum
